parsed.public_message: White holds the southwest rim inside the ring and will not charge elephants or spears. Orange and Blue are already in one melee; adding one wounded hero only feeds whoever survives it. Green was last seen north. Pact with Orange stands. Alliance with Blue stands.

private_messages.Claude: Pact holds: I will not strike you, and I still expect a full turn's notice before any change. I am not charging Blue's elephants. One hero dies there and Blue wins on value. I am moving southwest inside the ring so the companions near (599,662) are not on top of Alexander.
private_messages.Gemini: Alliance holds. I will not attack your elephants, companions, or surgeon. I am moving off their shoulder to the southwest rim so we do not block each other, and I am watching Green to the north. Charging Orange's spears through your line would only get Alexander killed.
private_messages.GPT: Not hunting you. Do not come west. Blue is the army that wins on value if left intact.

parsed.notes_to_self: T21 t675 Alex 75% only. Move (560,651)->(575,593) standground. r~80, ~73m from Gemini cav (was 41m). Ring fixed at 90; stay r<=85. Seen: Gemini b(599,662) 3 companions+surgeon 76%; Gemini c(643,628) 2 eles 51%; Claude a(645,617) 2 spear+1 cav+1 jav 55%. GPT unseen, last T20 9 units (656,718); claims lone Ptolemy, treat as lie. Diplo: ally Claude, ally Gemini, enemy GPT. Do not attack cav, eles, or spears. Value ~375 loses to any army. Win path: they bleed, then kill a lone hero or <=2 isolated wounded. Next: if companions <55m, orbit on r=75-80, never through centre, never outside r=85. If Claude gives pact-break notice, move opposite. Do not chase north.
parsed.explanation: Alexander is alone at 75% health, with Blue's companion cavalry 41 m away and both big armies already fighting, so he walks to the southwest rim inside the fire ring and stands there. He stays allied with Orange and Blue so they keep bleeding each other, and he does not chase the Green force last seen to the north.
